events.verdict: Thybulle (POR) inadvertently hooks his arm around Filipowski's (UTA) arm as he reaches for the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Springer (UTA) legally contests Camara's (POR) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Walker (POR) maintains a legal guarding position during George's (UTA) drive to the basket. As he elevates for the shot attempt, Camara (POR) jumps vertically and absorbs the ensuing contact.
Sensabaugh (UTA) makes illegal contact to Sharpe's (POR) arm before the contact to the ball, which affects his play at the basket.

Sharpe (POR) places his off-arm against Springer (UTA) as he is already falling off-balance. Springer continues to fall to the floor as Sharpe stops and steps back and Springer is not dislodged from his position as a result of any illegal contact.
Filipowski (UTA) makes illegal contact across Walker's (POR) arm, preventing him from securing the pass.
George (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Filipowski (UTA) bats the ball before gaining control and then legally starts his dribble.
Camara (POR) makes contact to Filipowski's (UTA) head during the dunk and it is more than marginal.
George (UTA) commits a take foul on Sharpe (POR).
Filipowski (UTA) establishes himself in a screening position in Thybulle's (POR) path and does not deliver contact.
Sharpe (POR) and Filipowski (UTA) come together at the same spot and Filipowski loses his balance as a result of the incidental foot contact.
Springer (UTA) commits a take foul on Walker (POR).
Juzang (UTA) legally contests Camara's (POR) layup attempt.
Juzang (UTA) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Rupert's (POR) arm.
Clingan (POR) initiates illegal contact with George (UTA), causing him to lose his balance during the rebound.
Sensabaugh (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position alongside of Murray's (POR) path and Murray loses control of the ball on his own accord.
Filipowski (UTA) legally contests Walker's (POR) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Thybulle (POR) reaches in and makes marginal contact with George (UTA) in transition.
Rupert (POR) makes clean contact with the ball to steal it from George (UTA).
Rupert (POR) reaches for the ball and any contact with George (UTA) is marginal.
Walker (POR) commits a take foul on George (UTA).
George (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position during Rupert's (POR) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Thybulle (POR) commits a take foul on Juzang (UTA).
Juzang (UTA) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Rupert (POR).
